outcomes: Encode and decode bounded binary frames with explicit corruption and incomplete-tail behavior.
Append all bytes despite short writes and synchronize before acknowledgement.
Index latest values and deletions without prototype-key errors.
Encode atomic batches and apply only committed operations.
Recover committed prefixes, fail closed on corruption and repair before appending.
Provide a usable single-writer store and safely replace its log during compaction.
Inject faults at byte and operation boundaries and explain observed recovery limits.
